fields.acceptance: A test in cmd/rhiza/testdata/script covers three cases with rhiza inbox --json. (1) An interrupted run on a landed change set that reached land has no skipped item. (2) The same kind of run, resumed by the daemon and then interrupted again, has a gave-up item, and one that failed a step after land has a failed item. (3) An interrupted build run on a landed change set that never reached land is still listed as skipped with rhiza run abandon
fields.statement: rhiza inbox does not list as skipped an interrupted non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached its land step, since the daemon resumes it; and it does not treat such a run's change set as gone, so if that run is interrupted again after the daemon's resume it is listed as gave-up, and if it fails a later step (such as main-green) it is listed as failed, as any other run
